import-exponentials-logarithms-1a78378b3069da66 a city has 365400 vehicles this year. its vehicle count increases by 5% annually.

(a) find the count after 7 years to 3 significant figures.

(b) will the count after 14 years be twice this year’s count? explain.

(c) winnie claims the percentage increase over the first 7 years is half the percentage increase over the first 14 years. do you agree? explain. 某市今年有 365400 輛汽車,數目每年增加 5%。

(a) 求 7 年後的數目,取三位有效數字。

(b) 14 年後的數目會是今年的兩倍嗎?解釋。

(c) winnie 認為首 7 年的百分增幅是首 14 年的一半。你同意嗎?解釋。 s4/exponential and logarithm/exponential function review.pdf · q13 s4/exponential and logarithm/exponential function review.pdf · 第13題 compare growth periods · 比較增長期

import-exponentials-logarithms-ae52a5daff6de71b an antique was worth 200000 dollars at the beginning of 2000. its value in dollars after \(t\) years is \(w=ka^t\), where \(a,k\) are constants. at the beginning of 2010 it was worth 600000 dollars.

(a) find \(k\).

(b) will its value at the beginning of 2020 be nine times its value at the beginning of 2000? explain. 一件古董在 2000 年初值 200000 元,\(t\) 年後的價值(元)為 \(w=ka^t\),其中 \(a,k\) 為常數。它在 2010 年初值 600000 元。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 在 2020 年初的價值會是 2000 年初的九倍嗎?解釋。 s4/exponential and logarithm/exponential function review.pdf · q14 s4/exponential and logarithm/exponential function review.pdf · 第14題 compare growth periods · 比較增長期
